name: flipper-claude-buddy
description: Flipper Zero as a physical remote control and feedback device for Claude Code. Provides sound, vibration, and display feedback on a Flipper Zero connected via USB.

serial_port.title: Serial Port
serial_port.description: Serial port for Flipper Zero USB (leave empty for auto-detect, e.g. /dev/cu.usbmodemXXXX)

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Transport to use: 'auto' (default, tries USB then BLE), 'usb', or 'ble'

bluetoothName.title: Bluetooth Name
bluetoothName.description: Flipper Zero BLE device name (required for BLE — shown in the Flipper mobile app, e.g. 'Flipper Abcdef'). In this fork a configured name must match EXACTLY, and a device advertising the Flipper service UUID under a different name is rejected.

bluetoothAddress.title: Bluetooth Address (pin)
bluetoothAddress.description: Optional. Only connect to this exact BLE address, ignoring name and service UUID — the strongest protection against another device impersonating your Flipper over BLE. Find it in /tmp/claude-flipper-bridge.log: 'BT: found <name> (<address>)'.

permissionDetail.title: Permission Detail
permissionDetail.description: FALLBACK ONLY — set this on the Flipper instead (Menu → 'Prompt: …', long-press RIGHT). The device's setting always wins; this is used only when running a .fap too old to report one. Values: 'description' (default), 'command', 'both'.

vscodeFocusHotkey.title: VS Code Focus Hotkey
vscodeFocusHotkey.description: Hotkey the bridge presses to put the caret in the Claude Code input when running as the VS Code extension. Must be bound to the 'claude-vscode.focus' command in VS Code's keybindings.json. Default: cmd+ctrl+alt+j
